items.caption: A seal-script form of 先 associated with the received 說文 account, which analyzes the character as 从儿从之. This later dictionary analysis differs from the proposed Shang person-and-foot construction.
items.alt: A single black seal-script glyph for 先 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The visible form is legible and provides a useful comparison with the distinct early person-and-foot interpretation; the image itself does not establish continuity between them.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw in Shuowen seal-script style, not an image of an ancient artifact. Early forms are broadly interpreted as a person beneath a foot, but the evidence does not establish their complete graphic development into modern 先.
